page.layout: One printed page. Running head centred at top with page number 100 at left. Heading in capitals with italic subtitle below. Central engraving (emblem picture) in a framed box. Below the picture, a four-line verse in italic, set centred-left. Catchword-like word "Multa" at lower right, alone.

main_text.head: ATROCIBVS DELICTIS, atroces pœnæ.
main_text.p:
Auri sacra fames, madidi malus vsus Iacchi,
Et venus, Imperiis vltima fata ferunt.
Quo finis propior, magis hoc quoq; crimina crescunt,
Præcipitat pœnas & mala turba graues.

page.notes: The engraving shows a tent with a flag, a seated figure inside with a pot, a man with a book at right, a smoking castle on a hill, a city, and a hanging bundle above. Verse lines are set as one stanza. The word at lower right reads "Multæ" as far as legible; the final letters are partly worn.
